name: Brawling Blademaster
summary: Brawling blademaster samurai use weapon strikes and unarmed attacks in equal measure
replacesText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency; Mount; Weapon Expertise; Mounted Archer; Banner; Greater Banner
mechanicalNotes: Weapon, armor, and shield proficiencies are replaced exactly; Improved Unarmed Strike and Two-Weapon Fighting are granted automatically.
Samurai and Monk levels stack for the visible unarmed-strike damage progression, and Nimble scales through level 18.
Harmonious Flow, Perfect Clarity, and Superior Focus expose their exact challenge-conditional modifiers.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.summary: Brawling blademasters are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, plus the katana and wakizashi. Brawling blademasters are proficient with light armor, but not with shields. This alters the samurai’s weapon and armor proficiency.

features.name: Empty Hand (Ex)
features.summary: A brawling blademaster gains Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. She uses her samurai level as her monk level for determining the amount of damage she deals with an unarmed strike. These levels stack with monk levels to determine the brawling blademaster’s unarmed strike damage. This replaces mount.

progressionProfiles.label: Unarmed strike damage
progressionProfiles.summary: Use the combined Samurai and Monk level for this Monk-equivalent unarmed-strike damage progression.

features.name: Nimble (Ex)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a brawling blademaster gains the gunslinger’s nimble class feature, using her samurai level as her gunslinger level.

features.name: Dual Expertise (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a brawling blademaster gains Two-Weapon Fighting as a bonus feat, even if she doesn’t meet the prerequisites. Furthermore, when the brawling blademaster selects a feat with the bonus feat class feature, she can ignore any Dexterity requirements for the feat if its prerequisites include the Two-Weapon Fighting feat. This replaces weapon expertise.

features.name: Harmonious Flow (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level, the brawling blademaster becomes skilled at combining weapon attacks and unarmed strikes into a harmonious combat style. When attacking the target of her challenge, the brawling blademaster doesn’t take the usual –2 penalty on attack rolls associated with attacking with two weapons if her main-hand weapon is a light or one-handed manufactured weapon and her off-hand weapon is an unarmed strike (or vice versa). While she’s using this ability, one of her hands must be empty even if she uses another body part to make an unarmed strike. This replaces mounted archer.

features.name: Perfect Clarity (Ex)
features.summary: At 5th level, the brawling blademaster sees all her foes with perfect clarity even when focused on one opponent. She no longer takes a penalty to her AC during a challenge. This ability replaces banner.

features.name: Superior Focus (Ex)
features.summary: At 14th level, the brawling blademaster gains a +2 bonus on saving throws during a challenge. This replaces greater banner.

conditionalModifiers.label: Nimble — Armor Class
conditionalModifiers.condition: while wearing light or no armor

conditionalModifiers.label: Harmonious Flow — attack-roll penalty offset
conditionalModifiers.condition: attacking the challenge target with a light or one-handed manufactured weapon and an unarmed strike, with one hand empty

conditionalModifiers.label: Perfect Clarity — challenge AC penalty offset
conditionalModifiers.condition: during a challenge; this removes the normal challenge Armor Class penalty
